integrity: The polynomial generator identities and invariant-plane characteristic polynomial were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. The source equations, positivity assumptions, unique equilibrium, numerical parameter set, and stated analytical scope were checked against the inspected full text and arXiv record.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and periodic orbits, not unbounded trajectories.
It does not prove existence of a nontrivial compact recurrent set for every positive parameter quadruple.
It does not classify the multiple basins reported numerically in the source.
It provides no Lyapunov, entropy, fractal-dimension, or least-period estimate.
Targeted search cannot exclude a differently phrased or unindexed later statement of the same stationary identities.
title: Stationary unit-amplitude locking and positive-half-space selection in the Bouali Type III flow
